When Zola steals the Rescue-Webs Firetruck, he learns that being a hero isn't so easy; when Symbie slimes the city, Team Spidey chases him to his Slime Factory to stop him.

title: Marvel's Spidey and His Amazing Friends
description:
S05 E02 — One Fantastic Surprise Party; Kitty Cat Chaos
Spidey helps Mr. Fantastic when his hiccups cause him to change shapes; after a potion turns them into kittens, Spidey and Spin must get creative to defeat Lizard.
